messages.body: Hi, I saw your ad for the 1 bed on Marlow Road. Is it pet friendly? I have a cat.

messages.body: Hi Aiden, the landlord would consider a cat for a small extra deposit. Rent is 1,150 pcm. Want to come and see it?

messages.body: Yes please, weekend?

messages.body: Yes sorry, receipt attached. References are being processed.

messages.subject: Re: Viewing feedback
messages.body: I'm still interested, but I'd like to know whether pets are allowed before I commit.

messages.subject: Re: Viewing feedback

messages.subject: Re: Highfield Rise - sorry

messages.body: See you then.

messages.body: Hello, I'm interested in the 2-bedroom flat at 14 Elm Street listed at 1,350 pcm. Is it still available? Could I view this week?

messages.body: Hi Aiden, yes it's available. Viewing slots: Thursday 5 June at 17:30 or Saturday at 11:00.

messages.subject: Re: Enquiry: 2 bed flat, 14 Elm Street

messages.subject: Re: Enquiry: 2 bed flat, 14 Elm Street

messages.body: OK, I'll transfer the holding deposit today.
